facts.title: The saffron
facts.text: Saffron is made from the dried red stigmas of the Crocus sativus flower. Its place in the kitchen is both visual and aromatic: a small ingredient that invites a little attention.

facts.title: Your first ritual
facts.text: Start with a saffron recipe and follow its preparation instructions. Infusing the threads in warm liquid is a common first step.
facts.linkText: Read our guide to using saffron.

facts.title: A little care
facts.text: Keep your saffron in an airtight container away from light, and follow the storage instructions on its packaging.
